seen_animation: A grey line scene (house, two trees, ground line) stays fixed at the top. Below it a black-line baseball bat is held by two long arm strokes that end in round hands. In frame 1 the bat is short and tilted up to the right, in the upper middle of the frame. Over frames 2-8 it moves down and slightly left, rotates toward horizontal, and gets longer. By frames 9-10 it is nearly horizontal and longer. In frames 11-16 the right end dips so the bat tilts down to the right; it reaches its full length near the bottom of the frame and holds there with small changes. The left arm stays bent at the elbow; the right arm becomes a straight vertical stroke whose hand slides toward the middle of the bat.
seen_film: A boy in a patterned shirt stands in a schoolyard holding a baseball bat at waist height with both hands, looking down at it. Frame 1 to 2 shows a dissolve/cut into the shot. In frames 2-8 the bat is tilted up to the right and short (foreshortened); he lowers its far end so it becomes horizontal and longer. From about frame 8 he raises his head and looks to his left at the children behind him while the bat continues to tilt slightly down to the right. In frames 13-16 the bat is long, tilted down to the right, barrel on the left and knob on the right, low in the frame, and he looks down again at the end.
named_subject: A baseball bat (thick barrel on the left, taped handle with knob on the right) held by two hands.
